# NEXORA

NEXORA is a productivity and self-development app designed to bring planning, learning, routines and personal reflection into one space.

## Current app areas
- Tasks
- Study
- Routines
- Trackers
- Journaling
- Mindful breathing
- Focus Sprint
- Discipline Sprints
- Current Affairs
- Past Analytics
- Time Tools

## Planned development
- Personal profiles and an account centre
- Optional sign-in with Google, Apple, phone and email
- Guest-first access and safe guest-data continuity when connecting an account
- Community and sharing concepts
- NOVA AI concept

Profile, account, community and NOVA AI items are planned development, not claims that these features are currently live. The coming-week profile/account items are development targets and may change after testing.

Privacy Policy and Terms pages are drafts until actual production data practices and legal details have been verified.
